Education

The rule for this page

A case counts as education if its named party contains "university", "college", "school", "academy", "seminary" or "conservatory", and is not one of a short list of businesses that use "school" as a brand word and are not one (a driving school, a beauty school). Within that: a name also carrying a hospital word is a teaching hospital, not the school itself. A name also carrying "bus", "transportation", "dining", "food service", "custodial", "cleaning" or "security" is a contractor working at a school. A case whose named party starts with a union's own name, the school following in parentheses, is filed under the union's name rather than the school's, and is sorted here by the school anyway.

A name missing from this page is not proof of no union. Three reasons a workplace could have one anyway and still not show up here: the employer recognized the union without an election, so no petition was ever filed; the election was certified before this site's copy of the results begins (February 2010); or the employer is a public institution, outside the National Labor Relations Act entirely, and organized if at all under a state's own public-employment law.

Colleges and universities with an election count here (441)

The count the Board reported, never who won. Every election this site holds covers the same ground, by month.
